info.name: SMKlog Quote API 1.4.0
info.description:
Live parcel rates from USPS, UPS, FedEx and DHL Express for a single shipment sent from a US origin: inside the US, or to Canada, the UK, Germany or Australia. Describe the item in plain words and the packed box size and weight are estimated server-side; supply exact dimensions and weight to skip the estimate. No account and no key. Rate limited per client (about 80 quote requests per hour); quotes cost real money to produce, so cache on your side and do not poll. Buying a label happens on smklog.com — this API prices, it does not sell.

Generated by SMKlog from the live OpenAPI document (https://quote-api.smklog.com/openapi.json) on 2026-10-19. No key needed: every request runs as-is.

item.name: Price one parcel from a US origin across USPS, UPS and FedEx (plus DHL Express to Germany and Australia)

request.description: Prices one shipment live against the carriers for the lane. Name the item in plain words and the packed box is estimated server-side (the estimate, its confidence and its assumptions come back in package); send length_cm, width_cm, height_cm, weight_kg and package_source "manual" to price an exact box instead. Up to five purchasable services come back, each a checkout total with the SMKlog fee inside and the carrier counter price beside it. One call per shipment: every call spends a live carrier rating.

item.name: Create or update (upsert) a payment session for one parcel label (MPP intent "session")

request.description: Prices the shipment live, anchors the amount to one service, and returns a handoff URL opening the SMKlog checkout prefilled with the shipment. The human confirms the contents certification and the carrier-adjustment consent there and pays on Stripe hosted checkout. This operation never charges: the agent prepares, the human pays. Pass the quote_id from getParcelQuote and the session reuses that quote instead of spending a second carrier call. Create-or-update: send your own external_id (an order or cart id) and the call creates the session if it does not exist for that external_id, or re-prices it in place if it does (same session_id; new amount, service and handoff_url). created in the answer says which branch ran. A session whose checkout the human has already started is not changed: that call answers 409 session_in_checkout with its session_id. Without external_id every call creates a new session. external_id needs a bearer token from /oauth/token and is scoped to that OAuth client, so another client sending the same id reaches a different session; without a token it answers 401 token_required. Retries with the same external_id are idempotent: a timeout or a repeated call never creates a duplicate session. A session lives 30 days from its last create or update; after that the same external_id creates a new one. Optional callback_url: SMKlog POSTs each later stage of the session to it, signed (see the webhooks section), so nothing needs polling. Optional dry_run: price and validate without storing anything. cancelPaymentSession reverses a session the human has not opened yet.

response.name: 200 The session: intent, method, amount, currency, service, handoff_url, session_id,

item.name: Read where a payment session stands

request.description: The stage of the checkout a payment session led to: awaiting_checkout, checkout_started, paid, label_ready (with the tracking number), delivered, refunded, or cancelled (by cancelPaymentSession). Reads SMKlog order records only, no carrier call. Sessions live 30 days; an unknown or expired id answers 404 session_not_found. The answer never carries names, addresses or emails.

item.name: Cancel a payment session before the human opens its checkout

request.description: Reverses createPaymentSession while nothing has happened on the human side. A session in awaiting_checkout is marked cancelled: its handoff link stops binding a checkout to it, its external_id is released for a new session, getCheckoutStatus answers status cancelled with cancelled_at, and a callback_url hears payment_session.cancelled. Window: until the human opens the handoff link. From checkout_started on the call answers 409 session_in_checkout and nothing changes; an unpaid checkout simply expires with the session, and a paid one is refunded by SMKlog support against the order_id getCheckoutStatus reports, never through this API. Idempotent: cancelling a cancelled session answers 200 with the same status. No carrier call and no quote allowance; the status bucket (60 an hour per client) applies.

response.name: 200 The session, now cancelled: status cancelled, cancelled_at set, checkout null
response.body:

  "session_id": "as_3f9c1b2e-7d64-4a8e-9c0f-5b2d1e8a7c33",

  "currency": "USD",

  "quote_reused": true,
  "cancelled_at": "2026-10-12T15:06:30.000Z",
  "checkout": null,
  "next": "Cancelled by the agent. The handoff link no longer binds a checkout to this session; create a new session for a new attempt."
}
